parameters.help_en:
The quota alert type. Valid values:

used: alerts on the used quota. This is the default value.
usable: alerts on the remaining available quota
parameters.help_zh:
配额告警类型。取值：

used（默认值）：已使用量告警。
usable：剩余可用量告警
parameters.name: threshold_type

parameters.help_en:
The numeric value of the quota alert threshold. Valid values:

If ThresholdType is set to used, you receive an alert notification when the used quota is greater than or equal to the specified value. The quota alert threshold must be greater than the used quota.

If ThresholdType is set to usable, you receive an alert notification when the available quota is less than or equal to the specified value. The quota alert threshold must be less than the available quota.

You must specify either this parameter or ThresholdPercent
parameters.help_zh:
配额告警阈值的数值。取值：

当`ThresholdType`选择`used`时，如果配额的已使用量大于等于预设数值，您会收到告警通知。配额告警阈值必须大于配额的已使用量。

当`ThresholdType`选择`usable`时，如果配额的剩余可用量小于等于预设数值，您会收到告警通知。配额告警阈值必须小于配额的剩余可用量。

该参数与ThresholdPercent必须设置一个
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en:
The percentage of the quota alert threshold. Valid values:

If ThresholdType is set to used, you receive an alert notification when the used quota is greater than or equal to the specified percentage. Valid values: (50%, 100%].

If ThresholdType is set to usable, you receive an alert notification when the available quota is less than or equal to the specified percentage. Valid values: (0%, 50%].

You must specify either this parameter or Threshold
parameters.help_zh:
配额告警阈值的百分比。取值：

当`ThresholdType`选择`used`时，如果配额的已使用量大于等于预设百分比，您会收到告警通知。取值范围：（50%, 100%]。

当`ThresholdType`选择`usable`时，如果配额的剩余可用量小于等于预设百分比，您会收到告警通知。取值范围：（0%, 50%]。

该参数与Threshold必须设置一个
parameters.name: threshold_percent

You must specify both Dimensions.N.Key and Dimensions.N.Value. The value range of N depends on the number of dimensions supported by the cloud service. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440553.html operation to query the supported quota dimensions. The length of the returned array is the maximum value of N

parameters.help_en:
The quota dimensions.
The dimensions are properties of a quota item. A quota item is uniquely identified by Dimensions and QuotaActionCode.
Some dimensions are required for specific cloud services. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440553.html operation to query the supported quota dimensions of a cloud service. The Requisite response parameter indicates whether a dimension is required
parameters.help_zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度`Dimensions`+配额ID`QuotaActionCode`确定唯一的配额项。
部分云产品维度必填，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440553.html查询云产品支持的配额维度， 返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填
